target_customer: Developers building apps on Stable Diffusion
problem: Building on Stable Diffusion means choosing models, hyperparameters and prompts, adding guardrails against bad outputs, and securing high VRAM GPUs.
business_model: Developer platform: deploy workflows as scalable APIs plus evaluation tooling (pricing not stated)
product_category: Generative image model evaluation and deployment platform

founders.name: Eshaan Moorjani
education: UC Berkeley, computer science, graduated a year early
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page and launch post.

founders.name: Rajen Dey
education: UC Berkeley, graduated a year early
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page and launch post.

exit.reason: YC lists as inactive; vango.ai did not resolve when fetched; no public cause

competitors.name: Replicate
competitors.what: Hosting and running ML models including Stable Diffusion via API

technical_complexity.rationale: GPU orchestration, workflow deployment and automated quality metrics (deformed hands, NSFW, prompt alignment) across thousands of prompts is moderately hard for two people.

defensibility.rationale: Open source models and hosting platforms were commodity and the model landscape shifted quickly; evaluation tooling was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Hosting vendors and model makers added workflow and evaluation features; no source on specific actions against Vango.

market_need_then: Stable Diffusion adoption surged after its August 2022 release and developers needed ways to run it; the founders cite their own app building experience. No demand metrics given.

branding.domain_note: Used vango.ai; unrelated products named Vango exist (an art concierge product and others).

brand_strength.rationale: Waitlist stage, no press about the brand; other products share the name.

outcome_analysis: Vango pitched Stable Diffusion workflow tooling at a waitlist stage and raised only the YC note; the YC directory lists it inactive with no explanation and no later round or shutdown post was found, so the cause is not public. The tooling layer was easy to copy and model and hosting vendors moved quickly.
notes: The $500K round rests on databases (VCBacked, CB Insights, Extruct) that all trace to a YC convertible note around Sep 2023; no first party source. Founding year: YC says 2022, CB Insights says 2023. Extruct describes Vango as a consulting agency which conflicts with YC and was treated as unreliable. The Replicate entry rests on a TechCrunch headline only; its funding at that date was not read.
